note: A synthetic client (Slice 116 worked example). Not a real company.
problem: We sell scheduling software to dental clinics. Our outbound emails get a 1.5% reply rate and we need more meetings.

answers.common.decision: Which accounts and messages to use next quarter; the sales manager approves outreach.
answers.common.materials: We email 2,000 clinics a month. Clinics with larger practices reply at 4%. About 30% of our list are larger practices.
answers.sales-customer-coordination.targets: Dental clinics in the United States, our current prospect list.
answers.sales-customer-coordination.approver: The sales manager approves all outgoing messages.
